front/idle: Use case: stylized-concept. SIX SMALL isolated game animation sprites on a LARGE transparent sheet. Exact character I3, FRONT view, idle. Image1 canonical front; image2 opposite construction. Charcoal-gray plump seagull with cream cheek patches and cream belly/tail tips, gold feet/beak, angular tan-gold cracked stone crest, black shard outer wings with golden stone rims. Behind the small bird is its GIANT shadow-bird silhouette made of purple-black fractured mirror crystals with lavender cracks and detached shards. This giant aura silhouette is integral, retain its scale relative to small bird; include whole aura in each cell. Front aura has pale lavender eyes and beak; rear aura has NO face. Small bird's rear has no frontal face or cream belly. Match reference illustration/color/materials and all shapes faithfully. Keep front camera throughout. 3 equal columns by2 equal rows, 1536x1024, 512x512 cells. Whole bird+giant shadow aura+all mirror shards must be SMALL: occupy only 60% cell width/height, at most320x320px. Very wide EMPTY transparent gutters; all pixels must remain local x96..416,y96..416. Do not expand to fill cells! Six frames row-major: 1 neutral, 2 shallow inhale, 3 breath crest, 4 exhale, 5 settling, 6 near neutral for seamless loop. Very restrained secondary movement. Apply subtle coordinated shadow aura motion, never enlarge aura to cross gutters. Fixed orthographic camera, same scale, feet anchor local (256,416). True transparent RGBA, no floor/cast shadow, text, labels, lines, grid or background. No extra figures beyond canonical bird and its own shadow aura; no crop or overlap.
